snippet.title: Trump Just Lost Congress. Here's What History Says Happens Next
snippet.description:
Donald Trump lost Congress in the 2026 midterm elections: on November 3, Democrats won the House and the Senate. So what happens next in US politics? History has a clear answer: three fights. The veto, the investigations, and the war money.

We go back to 1946, when a senator from the president's own party told Harry Truman to resign. Then 1948, when a newspaper printed the wrong winner. 1868, when a president survived his own trial by one vote. And 1973, when Congress stopped a war without firing a shot. Then 2018 and 2019, when this president was here before. And the one key thing missing this time.

This is D-Cypher. The biggest stories, scandals and current events, deciphered.

CHAPTERS
0:00 Congress just flipped. It's happened before
1:37 1946: told to quit
3:07 What a president actually loses: the three keys
4:02 Fight 1: the veto
5:31 Fight 2: investigations and impeachment
6:34 Fight 3: the war money
7:40 He's been here before (2018–2019)
8:32 The key thing missing this time
9:14 What to watch in 2027
9:54 Which fight starts first?

Which fight do you think starts first: the vetoes, the hearings, or the money? Tell us in the comments.

SOURCES
Election results: CBS News, NBC News (Nov 4–5, 2026). Alaska and Mississippi Senate races still being counted at upload
Iran war-powers votes: NPR (Jul 23 and Sep 24, 2026), CNBC (Sep 24, 2026)

snippet.description:

Terbaru, Haaland kembali marah-marah di laga UCL city lawan Porto. Saat City melakukan serangan, Ilman Ndiaye gagal mengirim crossing karena kesusahan mengontrol bola dan justru menbuat bola keluar lapangan. Karena itu, Haaland pun sampai marah-marah. Bahkan, apabila City jadi degdrasi karena 115 pelanggaran, Haaland tambah marah besar dan dikabarkan siap bergabung ke Barca.

News Ki Pathshala : Modi का ऑपरेशन 3D देख विपक्ष क्यों घबराया घुसपैठियों के बुरे दिन शुरू?

मोदी सरकार की 3D नीति यानी Detect, Delete और Deport को लेकर देश की राजनीति में बहस तेज है। इस नीति के तहत अवैध घुसपैठियों की पहचान, मतदाता सूची से उनके नाम हटाने और कानून के अनुसार उन्हें देश से वापस भेजने की बात कही गई है। उत्तर प्रदेश में SIR और वोटर लिस्ट को लेकर BJP और विपक्ष के बीच भी तीखी राजनीतिक बहस जारी है। BJP का कहना है कि मतदाता सूची में केवल भारतीय नागरिकों के नाम होने चाहिए, जबकि विपक्ष प्रक्रिया और वोटरों के नाम हटाए जाने को लेकर सवाल उठा रहा है। आखिर क्या है Operation 3D? क्या इससे अवैध घुसपैठ पर कार्रवाई तेज होगी? और 2027 के UP चुनाव से पहले यह मुद्दा कितना बड़ा राजनीतिक सवाल बन सकता है?

The Modi government's 3D policy — Detect, Delete and Deport — has triggered a political debate over illegal immigration, voter lists and national security. The policy focuses on identifying suspected illegal immigrants, removing ineligible names from electoral rolls and deporting those found to be staying illegally in India through due process. In Uttar Pradesh, the SIR exercise has added another layer to the political confrontation between the BJP and opposition parties. What exactly is the 3D policy? What are the arguments over voter-list revision? And how could this issue feature in the political debate ahead of the 2027 UP Assembly elections?

snippet.title: Salmón con salsa de naranja y huevas | Receta FÁCIL y elegante (Paso a Paso)
snippet.description:
¿Te gusta el salmón a la naranja? Entonces tienes que probar esta versión de Karlos Arguiñano: salmón con salsa de naranja y perlitas. 

La jugosidad del pescado y la frescura cítrica de la naranja combinan a la perfección, mientras que las huevas de salmón aportan un irresistible toque salino. 

📝 INGREDIENTES (4 personas):

4 rodajas de salmón fresco
3 naranjas de zumo
50g de huevas de salmón
2 dientes de ajo
80g de azúcar moreno
1 cucharada de salsa de soja
1 trozo de jengibre fresco
1 cucharada de harina de maíz refinada
Aceite de oliva virgen extra, sal, pimienta blanca y perejil

👨‍🍳 PASO A PASO (trucos en el vídeo):

Aromáticos: Pela y pica los ajos. Pela y ralla el jengibre. Corta 3-4 tiras (twists) de piel de naranja y exprímelas para sacarles el jugo.

Reduce la salsa: Pon el zumo de naranja en una sartén y agrega la soja, el azúcar, el ajo, los twists y el jengibre. Mezcla y deja reducir 10-12 minutos hasta que empiece a coger cuerpo.

Cuela y espesa: Cuela la salsa a una cazuela pequeña (separa los twists y córtalos en juliana fina). Diluye la harina de maíz en agua y agrégala para espesar. Al servir, introduce las huevas en la salsa y mezcla.

Marca el salmón: Calienta aceite en una sartén. Salpimienta las rodajas y cocínalas a fuego vivo por ambos lados, hasta que queden crujientes por fuera y suaves por dentro.

Emplata: Sirve una rodaja por ración y salsea. Esparce las tiras de piel de naranja en juliana y espolvorea con perejil picado.
